title: Oh no, oh no, oh no, no, no, no, no...
text:
Oh no, oh no, oh no, no, no, no, no.... I was so excited to find this online. The delivery was quick. Unfortunately, the pestle was broken and there was a hairline crack in the mortar. I requested a replacement with the hopes that I would have a great new set of tools for my kitchen. Welp, the replacement pestle was broken. I didn't even waste time looking to see the condition of the mortar. I guess I'll just have to go into a store to get one (so I can inspect it before leaving). This was disappointing. 😩

If you can get one that is not broken, this is a heavy set and will hopefully work well for you. Maybe I got all of the broken items.
